periods.label: Fri 18 Sep
periods.text: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then tending northwest to southwesterly in the late evening. Winds reaching up to 20 knots offshore north of Moruya Heads in the late evening. Around 1 metre. Southerly 2 to 2.5 metres. Sunny.
